# n8n_folders (Data Source)

Lists n8n folders in a project.

Results are paged internally using skip/take until the list is exhausted. Optional `name` and `parent_folder_id` filters are applied after listing. Folder APIs require an n8n license that includes `feat:folders`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "n8n_folders" "all" {
  project_id = n8n_project.example.id
}

resource "n8n_project" "example" {
  name              = "platform"
  delete_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project whose folders are listed.

### Optional

- `name` (String) When set, only folders with this exact name are returned.
- `parent_folder_id` (String) When set, only folders with this parent are returned. Use an empty string for the project root.

### Read-Only

- `folders` (Attributes List) Folders returned after following skip/take pagination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))
- `id` (String) Data source identifier. Always `folders:{project_id}`.

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Read-Only:

- `folder_id` (String) Folder ID.
- `name` (String) Folder name.
- `parent_folder_id` (String) Parent folder ID, or null at the project root.
